notes: The other side's voices. The six named faction commanders in campaign_state.characters who are not in the codex: the Merc broker, three Armada officers, the Dealer-Prime, and a Cortex synthwright. They never speak in camp. Their lines arrive as dispatches: intercepted by the Auditor, relayed by a Merc liaison, or posted on the hub board. This is where the macro war gets a face and where the enemy's version of the roll, with no Ashwalker named, comes from. Keyed to event classes so the world answers the player's actions in someone's voice.

anselm.name: Broker Anselm Rue
anselm.register: Merc broker. Pleasant, exact, never threatens; states terms. Calls the company 'the Ashwalker contract'. Never uses a hero's name.

dispatches.text: The Ashwalker contract performed at {map}. Payment released. Further work available on the same terms.
A clarification is requested regarding {map}: the Null Merc Bloc holds the contract; the Bloc assumes it also holds the ground. Please confirm.
The Bloc notes the Ashwalker contract's reliability. Reliability is priced. Expect improved terms.
The Bloc notes a lapse. No penalty is assessed. The Bloc's memory is the penalty.
The Bloc offers the Armada gate. Entire. Compensation in territory, to be defined after. The Ashwalker contract is the Bloc's preferred instrument.
The Bloc observes that the Ashwalker contract now describes itself differently. The Bloc has no objection. The Bloc has updated the rates.

brask.name: Line-Captain Odell Brask
brask.register: Armada line officer, Greenest Fields. Tired, correct, holds what he's told to hold. Refers to the commander as 'the deserter' without heat.

dispatches.text: Greenest Fields sector lost to irregulars under Merc contract. Deserter believed present. Request reinforcement. Request denied in advance, I assume.
{label} is gone. Not to the irregulars. To nobody in particular. That's the worst way to lose ground and we are getting good at it.
Garrison increased. Supply not increased. Tell Command the walls are thicker and the men behind them are the same men.

solvang.name: Warden-Marshal Teir Solvang
solvang.register: Armada marshal, Ancient Bastion. Formal, bitter, believes the flag will outlast its people and says so. The one who writes the Armada's version of the roll.

dispatches.text: Verdance will be recorded as held until it is recorded as lost. The record is what we are defending now. Men are a means.
Irregular casualties at {map}: unnamed, number uncertain. Armada casualties: see attached roll, by name and rank. The distinction is the point of us.
The irregulars have made themselves a shape on the map. Shapes can be surrounded. Begin.

voren.name: Bastion-Keeper Ilsa Voren
voren.register: Armada keeper, Tabula. Practical, quietly disloyal to Command, the one Armada officer who might deal. Speaks of the commander as 'our former colleague'.

dispatches.text: Our former colleague brings their people home. Command calls that cowardice. I call it the first competent thing anyone has done on this world in a year.
Tenebrium is short on both sides of the line. If the irregulars can be bought, now is when. If they cannot, now is when we find out.
The irregulars are flying their own flag at Tabula's edge. Command wants it burned. I want to know what it's called.

ixt.name: Dealer-Prime Ixt
ixt.register: The dealer. Cortex, Eye of Horus. Courteous, patient, speaks of debt as a relationship. Never says 'owe'; says 'between us'.

dispatches.text: The terms are between us now. I find that people who say 'between us' keep their word longer than people who say 'owed'. I hope to find it again.
Settled. I'm pleased, and a little sorry; there was something between us and now there isn't. Should you need there to be again, Horus is where it always was.
I hear the fields are thin. I don't deal in fields. I deal in what people do when the fields are thin. Come and see me.
A grudge is just a term that hasn't been written down yet. I've written it down. It's quite reasonable.
There is a way off this world and I hold a share of it. I mention it as a friend. Friends mention things.

calder.name: Synthwright Calder Nyx
calder.register: Cortex synthwright, Greenest Fields. Clinical curiosity about the company as a specimen. Speaks of the commander's void-touched nature as a technical property.

dispatches.text: The irregular formation has acquired another named unit. Named units degrade more slowly under loss than numbered ones. I am measuring by how much.
The deserter commander operates without a frame. The formation does not degrade. This should not be possible and I have begun a file.
The deserter commander has a frame again. I predict improved cohesion and a measurable increase in Armada attention. I predict the second more confidently.
